{{Quote|There's a power vacuum in the underworld with the big names gone&mdash;Nok Drayen, the Hatchet, Ivory&hellip;but I have a feeling you'll be up there one day.|[[Darmas Pollaran]] to [[Voidhound]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''The Hatchet''' was a prominent crime lord who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. His name was compared to likes of such masterminds as [[Nok Drayen]] and [[Ivory]], however he fell out of picture by the time of the [[Galactic War]].
